scores.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark theme with a deliberate blue accent (#4477AA) and clear panel hierarchy, but the color usage scatter plot renders as an undifferentiated wall of tiny dots that defeats its own encoding, and force-graph node labels at 9px are unreadable at the rendered size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bar chart, scaleSqrt for both network nodes and color scatter points, all domains data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max, and monthly time binning — minor gap is missing key functions in SVG data joins which risks positional corruption on filtered updates.
scores.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF pattern correctly prevents update storms and all canvas renders avoid mid-flight transitions, but brush closures capture scale references with no resize handler to refresh them, and a runtime ReferenceError on `store.setState` (line 970) breaks the thumbnail filter interaction entirely.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views with clear layout hierarchy (timeline → network+colors → list) stays within working memory limits, but the color-usage scatter is extremely dense — hundreds of sub-pixel dots make color matching near-impossible without hovering, and the force network labels overlap at this panel size.
